author: ETA PRIME
description:
Intel’s new XeSS 3 with Multi-Frame Generation is finally here, and it is a total game changer for budget PC builders. In this video, we’re testing the Intel Arc A380 low profile card to see if it can handle "XeSS 4X" mode. We managed to push Cyberpunk 2077 from a 41 FPS average to over 120 FPS! I’ll show you how to enable this feature on "older" Alchemist cards and discuss the latency tradeoffs between 3X and 4X settings.
